summary: Version 2 compiles (XeTeX, standalone tikz) and passed automatic Critic review with score 0.92, must_repair=false, no issues. The figure contains the segments A–D (horizontal), A–C (diagonal), D–C (vertical), the dashed O–C, a semicircular arc centred at O from M to D, a right-angle mark at D, and labels A, M, O, D, C. Version 1 failed only because the calc TikZ library was missing; the repair added it.
